script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: Paul says he did not find Titus in Troas, not that Titus was missing from a particular room or that his mind was on the one friend absent from it.
“I just read it out loud” comments on how Papa Dorin tells the passage.
“Jerusalem is a big name” is generic filler and doesn't make the explanation sound like Papa Dorin.
The office-supply joke treats the Spirit of God as something to buy, making a holy subject the target of the joke.
The contrast that stone stays in one place while a heart goes everywhere is not in the passage, and stone can be moved.
“Nobody has to bake the whole batch on their own strength” extends Paul's statement about his team's competence into a general promise the passage does not make.
